literature_photon.sentence: PHOTON BENCHMARK DOES NOT FAIL — no published direct bound excludes 153.5 µeV / 37 GHz at the quoted coupling. This does not clear the unresolved full fermion/flavour model.

fermion.verdict: The exact reduced normalization and aligned-current central benchmark are reproducible, but arbitrary anomalon portals can change Q_proj and generate flavour dependence. Exact full-v20 C_e,C_p,C_n and a full stellar/SN verdict remain open.

pta_strings.caveat: NANOGrav bounds depend on loop fraction f_NG and network model; (13,-3) holonomy still needs dedicated simulation.
pta_strings.verdict: Analytic Gμ=4.224e-13 sits below the oft-quoted 1e-10 NG ballpark and far below CMB 1e-7 — not excluded by frozen PTA anchors, but not proven either.

proton.verdict: Central M_GUT lifetime above SK; full MC still has ~35% SK-excluded fraction in v17.

bh_superradiance.verdict: Stellar-mass BH clouds are NOT in the v20 window; the cloud mass sits at asteroid-scale PBHs. Public stellar-BH catalogs therefore do not probe this mass. PBH microlensing is the relevant public path.

plasma_resonance.verdict: Resonance at 37 GHz needs n_e ~ 1.71e+13 cm^-3 — far above warm ISM/HII. Not a galactic-propagation smoking gun for v20.

cmb_mythbust.verdict: CMB maps cannot perform the v20 37 GHz DM line search

home_pc_priority_queue: Keep literature + fermion + PTA ledgers current
Query NRAO/ATCA for 36–38 GHz spectra on GRAVITAS sightlines

verdict: Inventoried 20 channels; 13 runnable now on this Python stack. The 37 GHz photon benchmark is not excluded, but the complete phenomenological model is not validated. Decisive evidence still requires B-field conversion and the open theory matching.
